map.Child-Pugh 与 MELD 有什么区别？: What is the difference between Child-Pugh and MELD?
map.Child-Pugh 用 5 项临床/实验室指标，分级直观但主观项（腹水、脑病）: Child-Pugh uses 5 clinical and laboratory indicators and grades intuitively, but the subjective items (ascites, encephalopathy) vary by physician; MELD uses creatinine, bilirubin, INR and sodium and suits end-stage liver disease queueing and short-term survival prediction. Clinically the two are often combined.
map.PT 延长和 INR 为什么要取较高分？: Why take the higher score when PT is prolonged and INR differ?
map.PT 延长秒与 INR 都反映凝血功能障碍，但受检测条件影响各自波动。取二者中较: Both PT seconds and INR reflect coagulation dysfunction but each fluctuates with test conditions. Taking the higher of the two avoids underestimating the coagulation abnormality, making grading more conservative and safer, especially for borderline patients.
